purpose: Retry the startup/tool canary after the TP=2 unpinned-KV startup OOM, with one controlled memory-profile change.
controlledDifferenceFromAttempt01: KV_MEM is now explicitly mapped through the local Compose override and pinned to 3000000000 bytes per TP worker. Model, image, TP, context, concurrency, GPU_UTIL, drafter, and sampling remain unchanged.
rationale: Attempt 1's startup log said TP=2 was sizing the KV pool from GPU_UTIL=0.93 because KV_MEM was unset; it then failed with a CUDA OOM before health.

The pinned source's multi-GPU guide says TP>1 skips the single-card pin by default, recommends reading the real pool and pinning before measurements, and a separate 3090 diagnostic example uses a 3 GB pin with a larger drafter.
The local override previously did not map KV_MEM into the container. docker compose config now confirms the explicit 3000000000-byte value reaches the single service.
passCriteria: server health succeeds and the startup log records KV pool size for both TP ranks
the canary calls read_file then write_file with exact allowlisted paths and call IDs
result bytes exactly match the fixed fixture and the final response is non-empty
redacted mode-0600 startup logs are saved before Compose cleanup
the candidate service is stopped and port 18142 is free after exit
failurePolicy: No Tool-Eval or automatic retry on failure; keep the full redacted log receipt and investigate before changing another variable.

validationUpdate.execution: CPU-only docker compose config under a transient user-systemd unit; no server, inference, or GPU compute was started.
validationUpdate.initialInvocationIssue: An earlier read-only check used bash -lc, which reset the working directory to /home/cristian and failed before Compose. The corrected unit used the explicit HyperQwen WorkingDirectory and passed; no service was started by the failed invocation.
